intent: Count how many of the 6 specified product lines have available_today_quantity >= 4 in the central Salzburg PowerTool store today.

params.fam2: Metabo Brushless BS 1OW-IK5 Cordless Drill Driver
params.fam3: Gardena Smart PowerMax 280-5FI Manual Garden Tool
params.fam4: Dresselhaus Outdoor Pro 1VG-P5G Wood and Drywall Screw
params.fam5: Holzmann Compact D 327-RR0 Compressor and Dust Extractor
params.fam6: Mobil All Season Super 1ZE-TCR Engine Oil

success_criteria: The central Salzburg PowerTool store resolves to exactly one open store_id.
Each of the 6 product lines resolves to its variant SKU via product_family_name + brand + the stated variant properties.
available_today_quantity for that store is joined per matched SKU (missing inventory row treated as 0).
Count = number of matched SKUs whose available_today_quantity >= 4.
refs include the record_path of every qualifying (available>=4) product and the store record_path; no unavailable product is referenced.

args: SELECT store_id, record_path, store_name, is_open FROM stores WHERE city = :city AND store_name LIKE :store_like;

WITH target_store AS (SELECT store_id, record_path AS store_path FROM stores WHERE city = :city AND store_name LIKE :store_like AND is_open = 1), matched AS (SELECT pv.product_sku, pv.record_path FROM product_variants pv JOIN product_families pf ON pv.product_family_id = pf.product_family_id WHERE pf.product_family_name = :fam1 AND pv.brand = :brand1 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties p WHERE p.product_sku=pv.product_sku AND p.property_key='fitting_type' AND p.property_value_text=:p1_fitting) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties p WHERE p.product_sku=pv.product_sku AND p.property_key='diameter_mm' AND p.property_value_number=:p1_diam) UNION ALL SELECT pv.product_sku, pv.record_path FROM product_variants pv JOIN product_families pf ON pv.product_family_id = pf.product_family_id WHERE pf.product_family_name = :fam2 AND pv.brand = :brand2 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties p WHERE p.product_sku=pv.product_sku AND p.property_key='voltage_v' AND p.property_value_number=:p2_volt) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties p WHERE p.product_sku=pv.product_sku AND p.property_key='battery_platform' AND p.property_value_text=:p2_batt) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties p WHERE p.product_sku=pv.product_sku AND p.property_key='kit_contents' AND p.property_value_text=:p2_kit) UNION ALL SELECT pv.product_sku, pv.record_path FROM product_variants pv JOIN product_families pf ON pv.product_family_id = pf.product_family_id WHERE pf.product_family_name = :fam3 AND pv.brand = :brand3 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties p WHERE p.product_sku=pv.product_sku AND p.property_key='tool_type' AND p.property_value_text=:p3_tool) UNION ALL SELECT pv.product_sku, pv.record_path FROM product_variants pv JOIN product_families pf ON pv.product_family_id = pf.product_family_id WHERE pf.product_family_name = :fam4 AND pv.brand = :brand4 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties p WHERE p.product_sku=pv.product_sku AND p.property_key='screw_type' AND p.property_value_text=:p4_screw) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties p WHERE p.product_sku=pv.product_sku AND p.property_key='diameter_mm' AND p.property_value_number=:p4_diam) UNION ALL SELECT pv.product_sku, pv.record_path FROM product_variants pv JOIN product_families pf ON pv.product_family_id = pf.product_family_id WHERE pf.product_family_name = :fam5 AND pv.brand = :brand5 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties p WHERE p.product_sku=pv.product_sku AND p.property_key='machine_type' AND p.property_value_text=:p5_machine) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties p WHERE p.product_sku=pv.product_sku AND p.property_key='voltage_v' AND p.property_value_number=:p5_volt) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties p WHERE p.product_sku=pv.product_sku AND p.property_key='power_w' AND p.property_value_number=:p5_power) UNION ALL SELECT pv.product_sku, pv.record_path FROM product_variants pv JOIN product_families pf ON pv.product_family_id = pf.product_family_id WHERE pf.product_family_name = :fam6 AND pv.brand = :brand6 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties p WHERE p.product_sku=pv.product_sku AND p.property_key='volume_ml' AND p.property_value_number=:p6_vol) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties p WHERE p.product_sku=pv.product_sku AND p.property_key='viscosity' AND p.property_value_text=:p6_visc)) SELECT m.product_sku, m.record_path, ts.store_path, COALESCE(si.available_today_quantity,0) AS available_today_quantity, CASE WHEN COALESCE(si.available_today_quantity,0) >= :min_qty THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS qualifies FROM matched m CROSS JOIN target_store ts LEFT JOIN store_inventory si ON si.store_id = ts.store_id AND si.product_sku = m.product_sku ORDER BY m.product_sku;

agents_md_constraints.rule: When answering availability questions - answer should reference products that are available, but should not reference unavailable products. Same with stores.
When responding with reference - provide full path in the repo to the object.
Note that inventory lives only in SQL projections
